name: Mr. Mime
description: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.description: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target drowsy.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, raising its defensive stats.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target.

moves.name: Mimic
moves.description: The user copies the target's last move. The move can be used during battle until the Pokémon is switched out.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its offensive and defensive stats.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description: The user emits a powerful flash of light to inflict damage on the target.
